subject: Renewal: evidence cadence & retention horizon change for expansion
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@novus.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal proposal + SOC2 re-attest planning

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the productive conversation yesterday. Per our call, I wanted to put the proposed renewal + expansion items in one place so your procurement and security teams can review: 

- Term: 12 months starting 2027-01-01 (we can shift start date to align with your fiscal month if needed)
- Committed throughput: +20% baseline GPU capacity (reserved pool) to accommodate your Q1 batch retraining jobs
- Retention: extend audit log retention window from 180 days to 365 days for the committed workload
- SOC 2 re-attestation: Redwood will provide the standard SOC 2 attestation letter and a scoped evidence bundle covering the retention uplift and log exports

I've attached a draft amendment (renewal-amendment-draft.pdf) that captures pricing tiers and the proposed amendment language for retention and throughput. Next steps we recommend:
1) Novus confirm 12-month term and committed throughput delta (20% vs. 10%).
2) Redwood compliance team to share a detailed evidence checklist and timeline.
3) Procurement to confirm DocuSign path and billing contact — Tom, looping you in per the call.

If Novus prefers a split retention (EU vs. US) we can accommodate with a region-sliced export; please flag that now so we can size the export/egress costs.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30 minute call this week to finalize.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Renewal Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: renewal-amendment-draft.pdf (pdf, 2 pages)
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@novus.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <procurement@novus.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal + SOC2 re-attest planning

Hannah —

Appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side before we move to legal/procurement: 

- Term: We prefer a 12-month term, yes. Can you confirm whether the pricing in the draft assumes a January start or is pro-rated?
- Throughput: 20% increase sounds reasonable but we need an estimate of the monthly committed token throughput and the expected spend delta.
- Retention: We need the evidence list for the 365-day retention and whether archived logs will be searchable for forensic pulls.
- SOC 2 re-attest: What is your proposed delivery window for the evidence bundle (e.g., 2–3 weeks after contract signature)? Also — please confirm whether the attestation letter will explicitly reference the retention change as a controlled configuration.

Looping Tom on the thread for procurement specifics. Tom — can you confirm who should be the billing contact and whether Novus requires a PO before DocuSign?

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Director, Information Security
Novus Finance

Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal + SOC2 re-attest planning — pricing and DocuSign path

Laura / Tom —

Thanks for the quick response. Quick answers and options so Procurement has what it needs: 

Pricing options (annual, committed):
- Option A — Standard 12m term, 20% committed throughput: list price (no discount)
- Option B — 12m term + 20% throughput + 10% commit discount (annual invoice upfront)
- Option C — 24m term + 20% throughput + 15% commit discount (if Novus wants longer price stability)

Pro-rating: We can pro-rate start-of-term if your legal prefers a mid-month start; the draft currently assumes a Jan 1 start but we will update the amendment language.

Evidence and SOC2: Rishi will lead evidence packaging. We can aim to deliver an initial evidence bundle within 10 business days of signed amendment for the items that are not time-boxed (policies, configurations, exports). For forensic log exports that require batching we'll coordinate an export schedule in the runbook.

DocuSign / billing: Our standard flow is DocuSign (link below) then invoice to your billing contact. If Novus requires a PO before DocuSign, we can accept a PO and place the DocuSign envelope on hold until payment terms are reconciled.

DocuSign link: https://app.redwood.com/docusign/NW-2026-0912
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/novus-renewal-evidence

I've attached an evidence index CSV to help map artifacts to audit controls (evidence-index.csv).

Let me know which option you prefer and whether Procurement needs an SOW line for the retained throughput.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence-index.csv (csv, 1 page)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@novus.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal + SOC2 re-attest planning — evidence plan and log handling

Hi Laura / Hannah / Kim —

Thanks — quick compliance plan and asks from the Redwood side: 

1) Evidence scope: For the retention uplift to 365 days we will provide:
   - System configuration exports showing retention policy (retention-config.json export)
   - Sample audit logs (redacted PII) for the last 90 days and a scripted export for a historical 365-day slice
   - SOC 2 attestation letter referencing retention change and committed throughput (signed)
   - KMS key rotation records and proof of customer-managed KMS integration if Novus opts in

2) Timing: We can produce the majority of artifacts within 10 business days of signature. The scripted historical export (365-day) requires a short maintenance window (1–2 hours) to snapshot and validate — we'll coordinate with your infra team.

3) Searchability: Archives will be stored in a queryable export format (compressed JSONL) that we can stage to your S3 bucket or to a secure transfer endpoint. For frequent forensic queries we recommend the region-sliced export (US / EU) — egress fees may apply.

4) Runbook: See attached runbook for upload steps, roles, and dry-run schedule. Request: Novus confirm the preferred transfer target (S3 bucket ARN or secure SCP endpoint) and point-of-contact for the maintenance window.

Costs: The retention uplift and the one-off historical export carry an estimated one-time engineering fee (hours) plus incremental storage/egress fees. I'll have finance produce a short cost worksheet once you confirm region and transfer method.

If Novus is amenable I suggest a joint 30 minute kickoff next week to lock the runbook and schedule the snapshot.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence-upload-runbook.md (md, 4 pages)

Thanks for pulling this together. Novus confirms the following:
